name: Cat-Cow

instructions.description: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale as you gently arch through the spine, lift the chest slightly, and look forward comfortably.
Exhale as you round the spine, draw the ribs inward, and let the head follow the curve.
Continue alternating slowly between positions for smooth spinal movement.

performanceMetrics.notes: Move continuously at a comfortable rhythm.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform the same spinal motion while seated on a chair.

commentsNotes: The movement should feel smooth, not forced.
Distribute the motion through the whole spine.
